mentions.name: Keyboard-only voxel editor
mentions.description: A keyboard-only voxel editor that renders cube-based 3D models and exports them as OBJ and STL files, built on the premise that simple cubes cover ~95% of 3D modelling needs.
mentions.source_excerpt: The start (rendering) of a basic voxel editor for generating OBJ and STL files with just the keyboard. To solve 95% of my 3D modelling needs it turns out I likely just need cubes.

evidence.value: The start (rendering) of a basic voxel editor for generating OBJ and STL files with just the keyboard. To solve 95% of my 3D modelling needs it turns out I likely just need cubes.
